region_note: The page publishes one rate card for commercial regions and names US East (N. Virginia) in its examples; it does not state per-region rates. Treat every figure as a list-price estimate and check the page for your region.

microvm_v2.billing: per second on actual consumption, 1-second minimum; CPU scales to zero during I/O wait; memory reclaimed after 120 s idle

instances.note: EC2 instance price plus an AgentCore management fee (12% standard, 7.8% GPU); not modelled here

gateway.note: API invocations such as ListTools, InvokeTool and Ping. Lambda, HTTP and other target costs are billed by those services.

memory.note: Custom/override strategies also incur model usage in your account.

observability.note: Charged at Amazon CloudWatch and X-Ray prices; not modelled here.

free_tier.note: New AWS customers receive up to $200 in Free Tier credits (account-level, not AgentCore-specific).
